data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add threshold-mode enforcement: when mutation.calibration.completed=true and a stack's mutants_generated>0, compare its kill rate to mutation.threshold.<stack>.min_kill_rate; on breach auto-create a bug ticket with a structured 4-field blurb and content-hash dedup.
**Why**: Closes the feedback loop — surviving mutants become bug tickets that flow through /dso:fix-bug and 69e8 negative-example graduation (the steering-loop instance).
**Scope**:
- IN: gate on mutation.calibration.completed and per-stack mutants_generated>0; per-stack kill-rate vs min_kill_rate comparison; bug creation via .claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug pushing to the tickets orphan branch using the CI auth pattern; retry-with-backoff (3 attempts) and TICKET_CREATE_FAILED artifact + workflow annotation on final failure; 4-field blurb (CONTEXT/WHAT/THRESHOLD/NEXT_STEP, max 60 words total) where CONTEXT links to behavioral-testing-standard.md Tier-3 rationale and the 411b epic; content-hash dedup tag mutation-breach-<sha> where sha=hash(stack, source_file, mutant_locations); set detected_by:tests classification field and detected_by:tests tag (per a34c-b345 observability coordination).
- OUT: calibration surfacing (draft-3); onboarding/setup integration.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the enforcement step runs only when mutation.calibration.completed is true and a stack's mutants_generated is greater than zero, and compares that stack's kill rate against mutation.threshold.<stack>.min_kill_rate ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, a kill-rate breach auto-creates a bug ticket via dso ticket create bug with retry-with-backoff over 3 attempts, writing a TICKET_CREATE_FAILED artifact plus a workflow annotation on final failure ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, the auto-created bug's CONTEXT field links to the behavioral-testing-standard.md Tier-3 rationale and the 411b epic, and the assembled CONTEXT/WHAT/THRESHOLD/NEXT_STEP blurb is at most 60 words total ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, the content-hash dedup tag mutation-breach-<sha> derives from (stack, source_file, mutant_locations) such that the same triple recurring across DISTINCT PRs produces the same tag and a single bug (no duplicate), while structurally-similar mutants in DIFFERENT source files produce different hashes and never collide into one bug ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, the auto-created bug includes a one-sentence WHAT field describing what mutation testing caught ← Validates Closure Check: "WHAT — one sentence on what mutation testing caught"
- When this story is complete, the auto-created bug includes a THRESHOLD field naming the specific threshold that fired plus the current kill rate ← Validates Closure Check: "THRESHOLD — specific threshold that fired plus current kill rate"
- When this story is complete, the auto-created bug includes a NEXT_STEP field instructing the investigating agent to investigate surviving mutants and not adjust the threshold ← Validates Closure Check: "NEXT_STEP — instructs investigating agent: investigate surviving mutants; do NOT adjust the threshold"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (threshold gate, breach detection, retry/backoff, content-hash dedup, 4-field blurb assembly under 60 words) ← Satisfies: sc-5

## Considerations

- [Security] Bug-creation pushes to the tickets orphan branch using the same CI auth pattern as the Jira bridge / outbound checkpoint; do not introduce a new credential path.
- [Coordination] Per epic comments, set detected_by:tests classification and tag so a34c-b345's observability epic attributes mutation breaches to the tests channel.
- [Correctness] mutants_generated=0 must produce no bug ticket (PR touched only non-mutable code); ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT must produce no bug ticket even in threshold mode.
- [Dedup-semantics] The content hash is over (stack, source_file, mutant_locations) only — never the PR number — so the same breach recurring across PRs collapses to one bug; source_file is part of the hash so similar mutants in different files cannot collide.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want threshold-mode enforcement that auto-creates a deduplicated bug ticket on kill-rate breach, so that undertested changes surface as actionable bugs after calibration.
